ctx.x: Curtis passed away maybe four or five years ago. Just almost made it into that Fathead [David Newman] style, almost, because that’s where he was coming from. He almost got into that Fathead. He could do it, but he just – it was just a hard thing to cross over and get into. He would have done good if he could have got to the East Coast and started playing the chitlin’ circuit, because that chitlin’ circuit made a lot of tenor players, especially with an organ. You come through, a tenor player with an organ, boy,…
If we could just, for the last time, go back and talk about your early days playing – picking up the vibraphone. You mentioned how you were called to do a gig to replace a pianist . . .
